title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a real-bulb model to Session 1: resistance that rises with temperature
body:
## Problem
Session 1 treats a bulb as a fixed 10 ohm resistor; a real filament's resistance rises several times when hot.

## Context
The Session 1 experiment already warns that real bulbs differ from the model.

## Expected outcome
An optional function `hot_bulb_current(v)` with a simple resistance that rises with the power in the bulb, a short note in the README, and a comparison figure.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The checkpoint still passes
- [ ] The new figure shows the current at switch-on and after warm-up

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a netlist reader
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: circuits are described by Python lists.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Real simulators read text netlists such as 'R1 1 2 1k'.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The text form of the two-loop circuit gives V_A = 6.545 V
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a diode and Newton's method
body:
## Problem
Session 3 solves only linear networks.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. Nonlinear parts need an iteration around the linear solver.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where a diode and a resistor are solved by Newton's method, with the load line picture.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] KCL residual below 1e-9 A in at most 10 iterations
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated schematic with a Thevenin load line
body:
## Problem
The Target animation sweeps a bridge resistor and redraws node voltages, branch currents and a Thevenin load line; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Node voltages agree with `solve_network` to 1e-9 V in every frame
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
